actions.description: Reset the simulated world to a scenario start state and return the initial observation. When a seed is supplied the endpoint records it in the receipt; otherwise the endpoint's declared default seed applies.

inputs.description: Seed passed to reset(seed=...); omit it to use the environment's next seed
inputs.name: seed

inputs.description: Options dictionary forwarded to the environment's reset()
inputs.name: options

actions.name: reset_world

actions.description: Advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags.

inputs.description: Control steps to advance; each is one environment step
inputs.name: ticks

inputs.description: Action object with an optional values vector; omit it for a physics-only step
inputs.name: action

inputs.description: Action vector forwarded to the environment
inputs.name: action.values

actions.name: step

facts.text: reset takes keyword-only seed and options and returns (observation, info)
step takes an optional action vector and fast flag and returns (observation, reward, terminated, truncated, info)
the physics timestep PHYSICS_DT is 0.002 s
the control frequency must be between 20 and 500 Hz
one control step is round(500/control_frequency) physics steps
the Mojo physics wrapper is created with timestep=PHYSICS_DT
a reset calls np.random.seed with the current episode seed
get_observation returns the enabled observation components: proprioception by default
the default ObservationConfig enables proprioception and no cameras
proprioception concatenates robot qpos and qvel and adds gripper and floating-base fields
get_info adds task_success as a float of the current success flag
LiftPotPosition clears and samples the workspace spawn boundary with min_distance 0.1 on reset
INITIAL_HEIGHT is 0.996 m and SUCCESS_HEIGHT is 0.1 m above it
the success rotation tolerance SUCCESS_ROT is 20 degrees
the base LiftPot reset places the pot at x=0.7, y=0.0 and z=INITIAL_HEIGHT

determinism.notes: the upstream reset(seed) calls np.random.seed with the episode seed (roboeval_env.py:558) and the fake draws its placeholder observation from random.Random(seed); a seed repeats the fake's state hashes, but the fake and upstream do not share a random stream or a physics model

gaps: the fake backend is a kinematic stand-in: it advances a step counter and a placeholder observation and integrates no rigid-body dynamics, contacts, actuators, sensors or noise; the upstream environment delegates physics to MuJoCo, which was not installed or run here
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0 and ticks advance the lockstep counter only

the physics timestep is 2 ms (PHYSICS_DT) and the control period is round(500/control_frequency) physics steps (20 to 500 Hz); the fake advances neither, and the control frequency is a constructor option rather than a fixed model parameter

the observation is a placeholder: the real default observation concatenates the robot qpos and qvel plus gripper and floating-base fields (roboeval_env.py:490-504), and its array length depends on the BimanualPanda model and was not computed here
the action object is forwarded as a values vector; the fake does not map it through an action mode or inverse kinematics
snapshot and restore are not offered by the environment
no run of, or comparison with, the upstream environment was made

measures.description: Control steps since the last reset
measures.name: tick

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: after an e-stop no step or reset is accepted until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch, and the observation stays readable
